annotations.title: Add a dish to the plan

description: Add one more dish to this plan. The ready time stays, so the new dish goes in at the ready time minus its cooking time and must still fit. Before the person taps Start it joins the plan on the sheet; afterwards it goes onto the phone too. Same rules as plan_meal: a plain-text name, at most 12 dishes. Needs the plan's code and control key.

code.description: The plan's code, or its whole link.

key.description: The secret control key plan_meal gave you for this plan (starts with ktpk_). Never show it or put it in a link.

steps.description: Optional moments inside the cooking time.
